metadata.case_name: CHAU KWAI HUNG v. LUK HING YU THOMAS

plaintiff.occupation_after: Taxi driver with reduced working days; after August 2018 traffic accident he has not resumed working as a taxi driver

injuries.description: moderate degree of soft tissue injury to the head/face
source: the plaintiff sustained moderate degree of soft tissue injury to the right wrist, the left middle finger, the neck, the head/face, and he also had other minor limb injuries.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of other or unspecified sites of head

injuries.description: moderate degree of soft tissue injury to the right wrist
source: the plaintiff sustained moderate degree of soft tissue injury to the right wrist, the left middle finger, the neck, the head/face, and he also had other minor limb injuries.
Subsequent examination revealed mild swelling and tenderness over the radial side of his right wrist with decreased range of movement.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of radiocarpal joint

injuries.description: moderate degree of soft tissue injury to the left middle finger
source: the plaintiff sustained moderate degree of soft tissue injury to the right wrist, the left middle finger, the neck, the head/face, and he also had other minor limb injuries.
There was tenderness and swelling at the proximal interphalangeal joint of his left middle finger with limited active range of movement.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of interphalangeal joint of finger

injuries.description: moderate degree of soft tissue injury to the neck
source: the plaintiff sustained moderate degree of soft tissue injury to the right wrist, the left middle finger, the neck, the head/face, and he also had other minor limb injuries.

At the time of examination, the plaintiff no longer complained of residual pain or impairment in his left middle finger or his head/face. But he still complained of residual pain and impairment in his right wrist/hand and neck.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon at neck level

source: the plaintiff sustained moderate degree of soft tissue injury to the right wrist, the left middle finger, the neck, the head/face, and he also had other minor limb injuries.

mild swelling and tenderness over the radial side of his right wrist
decreased range of movement of the right wrist

limited active range of movement of the left middle finger
residual pain in his right wrist, left middle finger and neck (intermittent, worse with activities such as prolonged driving and controlling the steering wheel)
residual pain in his right wrist, left middle finger and neck (intermittent, worse with activities such as prolonged driving and controlling the steering wheel)

activities which cause increased stress to the right wrist/hand (eg controlling the steering wheel for over three hours) and neck (eg prolonged driving for say over three hours) can cause discomfort or even pain
whole person impairment estimated to be 2.5%

treatments_received: A&E treatment and discharge from Tuen Mun Hospital

losses.description: Residual pain and impairment in the right wrist, left middle finger and neck resulting from the assault; decreased endurance and need for more short breaks during prolonged driving.
Residual pain and impairment in the right wrist, left middle finger and neck resulting from the assault; decreased endurance and need for more short breaks during prolonged driving.
Residual pain and impairment in the right wrist, left middle finger and neck resulting from the assault; decreased endurance and need for more short breaks during prolonged driving.

Reduced ability to work as a full-time (5-6 days a week) taxi driver; initially able to work only 1-2 days a week and later 3-4 days a week, and requiring more rest breaks and subject to availability of taxis for hire.
